set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- Fresh isolated JVM and Scala.js projects resolve locally published candidate artifacts without dependsOn source projects.
- Gale consumes only public Ravel APIs and passes its relevant dense-array suite.
- image4s or another substantial consumer passes against the same candidate.
- At least one real Scala.js interop or visualization consumer compiles and executes.
- The report records internal-access needs, excessive copies, rank casts, missing operations, ownership ambiguity, and exception recovery friction.
- Consumer gates are wired into the authoritative release command.
set.title: Build fresh JVM, Scala.js, and sibling artifact consumers
